# Historical contract dashboard

Exact configuration, generated profile file, aliases and matching companion catalogue from `f6565d27`, immediately before the user-selected content promotion. The generated profile file has the same profile values with different JSON property order; keep both exact so persistence and reload exercise the original fallback/deduplication boundary. The native V3 runtime renders its 17 panels on three Pages using the existing public CSV/image bytes. These are independent fixtures for older structure, authoring, companion and failure journeys, not the practitioner's selected package.

The source Playwright project explicitly supplies the `legacy-contract` context cookie. The mock server and the two test-only Vite servers honor it for config, profiles and catalogue; companion bootstrap and handshake use the same catalogue. No cookie serves the actual public package. Selected-content, membership and practitioner-feedback journeys explicitly use empty storage state, and the four-panel M0 fixture retains its own selection/reset path. Production static tests still build and consume the actual package.

Keep source fixture selection local to the browser context. Do not alter public content, reintroduce V2 charts, or treat historical fixture passes as evidence of current package content. The shipped-content journeys provide that evidence separately.
